a: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
p: Fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ttaqā wa ṣaddaqa bi-l-ḥusnā fa-sa-nuyassiruhu li-l-yusrā…
m: As for he who gives and fears Allāh And believes in the best [reward], We will ease him toward ease. But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need And denies the best [reward], We will ease him toward difficulty.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
